directOffers.note: Official EWE Go tariff: 0.52 EUR/kWh at EWE Go-owned stations, same price AC/DC, no monthly base fee and no blocking fee on EWE Go stations. Partner-station 0.62 EUR/kWh and partner blocking fee remain eMSP/roaming and are excluded from the physical-CPO offer.
Current official EWE Go FAQ states ad-hoc charging without a tariff costs 0.84 EUR/kWh at EWE Go stations. No own-network blocking fee is published.

networkEvidence.policy: Attach only where the physical operator resolves to EWE Go; never propagate the 0.62 EUR/kWh roaming partner tariff to third-party physical CPOs.
